lines.en: So? Come on!
Explain yourself, Geller.
First you get my Rachel pregnant?
You got Rachel pregnant?
Who did?
You did!
Yes.
Yes, yes, I did.
But it was just a one-night thing.
It meant nothing.
Oh? Really?
That's what my daughter means to you? Nothing?
No, no, sir.
She means a lot to me.
I mean, I care. I love Rachel.
What?
Oh, but not in that way.
I mean, I'm not in love with her.
I love her like a friend.
Oh, really? That's how you treat a friend?
You get her in trouble and then you refuse to marry her?
Hey, I offered to marry her.
But I didn't want to.
Well, why not?
So you can spend your time with this tramp?
Tramp?
I'm sorry. Dr. Green, Mona, Mona, Dr. Green.
How could you have kept all of this from me?
I was going to tell you, but...
But what?
You figure you get what you want and then you dump her like you did Rachel?
Hey, I did not dump Rachel.
Rachel, nor are we still together.
Oh, um...
Can I just...
Why don't we just let the machine get that?
Hey, Ross, it's Joey.
There's a hooker over here and we thought maybe you'd know something about it.
No, no, no, no!
No, I need to lie down.
